scientific_integrity: Analytic local moment equations and a graphical coupling prove the result; finite-state checks only corroborate. A self-review is documented and independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only period-three kinetic Glauber chains, consecutive four-spin correlations, and small perturbations of an infinite-hot-site reference. It rules out direct ordered two-point factorization, not arbitrary modified representations. The finite-size generator tests do not certify infinite-volume results. Historical originality review is bounded and independent scientific validation has not occurred.
title: A four-spin obstruction to two-point factorization in a periodic three-temperature Glauber chain
